title: Find All Lonely Numbers in the Array
summary: Given an integer array, identify numbers that appear exactly once with neither x+1 nor x-1 present in the array.
statement: Given an integer array, identify numbers that appear exactly once with neither x+1 nor x-1 present in the array. Return these lonely numbers in any order.
constraints: A lonely value occurs exactly once and neither adjacent integer value occurs anywhere.
Return every lonely value in increasing order.
Duplicate occurrences make that value non-lonely.
hints: A frequency map answers uniqueness and neighbor presence in constant time per distinct value.
Count values, then require count one and absence of both value-1 and value+1.
The three map conditions exactly encode the definition, and sorting provides deterministic output without changing membership.
editorial: The three map conditions exactly encode the definition, and sorting provides deterministic output without changing membership.

tests.explanation: Ten and eight occur once and have no neighboring integer in the array.
Only one and five are unique and isolated from adjacent values.
